title: Premium Web Vertical Slice Quality Rubric

anchors.meaning: Functional but visibly incomplete or inconsistent.
Solid baseline indie quality with material shortcomings.
Cohesive premium release quality for the intended audience.
Distinctive, highly polished, and class-leading for its scope.

dimensions.name: Core control feel and readability
criteria: Movement is predictable, responsive, and expressive.
Crown Rush dash, charge, and hazards are clear and readable.

dimensions.name: World and stage differentiation
criteria: Goldenwind Forest stages introduce distinct platforming and encounter challenges.
Broken Throne boss fight features telegraphed phase transitions.

dimensions.name: Content value and pacing
criteria: Stage progression, secret areas, and boss battle form a coherent 50-70 minute arc.

dimensions.name: Visual, animation, and audio cohesion
criteria: Original custom pixel art, UI, effects, and audio tracks form a unified theme.

dimensions.name: Web browser stability and performance
criteria: Runs smoothly at 60 FPS in Chrome/Edge without memory leaks or frame drops.

dimensions.name: Accessibility and input coverage
criteria: Keyboard and Gamepad controls are rebindable and fully functional.

dimensions.name: Asset license and commercial clearance
criteria: All shipped assets have verifiable original or commercial license rights.
